about: Boss weapons (Dom + Strategy 2026-10-28): the weapon a boss of a V1 archetype (`opponent`) fights with and is drawn with. Boss 2 Gargantua is the executioner and wields a MAUL; boss 3 Arachne is the shieldmaiden and wields an AXE in one hand and a SHIELD in the other. Before this a foe's weapon was V1's row for its archetype (the executioner's scythe, the shieldmaiden's gladius). A zone spawn's kind (data/profiles.json, src/fight/spawn-kind.ts kindFightFor) whose `opponent` has a row here fights with `weapon` (a src/fight/weapon-defs.json row: its moves, reach, damage, timing, and V1's hero-rig blade sweeps for it, data/fight.json bladeTables) and is drawn with the same weapon (src/fight/boss-hand.ts, scene.ts). The archetype's guard, stats, specials and AI are untouched, so the shieldmaiden keeps her shield guard and the shield is the drawing of it. `clipsAs`: a 106 body carries no Maul_* or Scythe_* clips, so it plays this weapon's clip family (the sword family, as the Pitborn's cleaver does) until the bodies land with their own. `equip`: the grafted part, a file under src/assets/weapons/foe/ (cleaver = the Pitborn's; maul.glb = library hammer-01, axe.glb = library axe1h-208, shield.glb = library shield-213: re-framed OpenTrident library props Dom picked 2026-10-28, licence ruled no concern). `scale`: the drawn part scaled about its grip. `offhand`: a part on the other hand (null = none); kind `file` is a mesh under src/assets/weapons/foe/ (`file` = stem, root node BossShield, metres, face normal +Z; `scale` about its origin), loaded only with the boss body (its URL: FOE_OFFHAND_URLS in src/fight/scene.ts) and seated on `hand` at `offset` metres, `rotationDeg` Euler XYZ; kind `disc` (still supported) is a flat round board built in code (no file) sized in METRES in world space (`radius`, `thickness`), seated on `hand` at `offset` metres with `rotationDeg` Euler XYZ in that bone's frame. MOUNTING knobs (2026-10-28): `equip` is the part's file stem under src/assets/weapons/foe/ (to drop in an OpenTrident GLB: put the file there, add its one-line URL to FOE_EQUIP_URLS in src/fight/scene.ts and the stem to PACKED in scripts/build.mjs, name it here); `scale` grows the DRAWN part about its grip (the grafted node under the Grip106 seat; before, the socket bone was scaled, which moved nothing drawn); `grip` {offset metres, rotationDeg Euler XYZ} nudges the drawn part in the seat frame (the sim's reach is V1's blade tables and is untouched); `material` {colour, metalness, roughness} replaces the part's own look (null = the file's; the Pitborn's cleaver is near-black and vanished against Arachne's dark legs, so the placeholder wears iron grey). The shield `offhand` is parented to `hand` (lowerarm_l); its board axis (the face normal) is the board's local Y rotated by `rotationDeg` in the forearm's frame: on a Mixamo left forearm Y runs elbow to wrist, -Z is the back of the forearm (away from the palm), so rotationDeg [-90,0,0] puts the face outward and `offset` [0, 0.14, -0.07] seats it between elbow and wrist with a small gap (radius, thickness, offset, rotationDeg are the tuning knobs; scripts/boss-walkin-stills.mjs METRIC=1 prints the clearance to head and chest). `placeholder`: exactly what is a stand-in, so nobody mistakes it for art. Presentation and the sim's weapon id only; the archetype's other rows are untouched. ?bossweapon=v1 puts every boss back on V1's weapon (and the drawn part); ?bossweapon=<opponent id> (stills) draws that row's weapon on the page's own foe (the Minotaur body) without changing the sim. Rows are checked by src/sim/validate.js (keys) and src/fight/boss-weapon.ts validateBossWeapons (values), at load.

placeholder: mesh: a library prop, OpenTrident weapon library hammer-01 (a spiked wooden club-maul, 1 m), re-framed to the grip as src/assets/weapons/foe/maul.glb and scaled 1.15x; a picked prop, not a maul drawn for Gargantua
clips: the 106 body plays the sword clip family (clipsAs cleaver), not Maul_* swings; the sim keeps the maul's moves, timing and damage
sweeps: V1's hero-rig maul blade table, not re-baked on Gargantua's body (his body is not in the repo yet; scripts/foe-body/bake-blades.mjs is the re-bake)
axe: a library prop, OpenTrident weapon library axe1h-208 (a steel double-bit one-hander, 0.7 m), re-framed to the grip as src/assets/weapons/foe/axe.glb; a picked prop, not an axe drawn for Arachne

shield: a library prop, shield-213 (a round ornate targe, 0.75 m), src/assets/weapons/foe/shield.glb, seated on the left forearm (offhand kind file); the sim's shield guard is unchanged, the mesh is only its drawing
clips: the 106 body plays the sword clip family (clipsAs cleaver); her shield arm is the clip's own arm, not the shield carry
sweeps: V1's hero-rig cleaver blade table, not re-baked on Arachne's body (not in the repo yet)

mesh: a library prop, OpenTrident weapon library sword1h-210 (a slim one-hand blade, 0.95 m), re-framed to the grip as src/assets/weapons/foe/katana.glb; a picked prop, not a katana drawn for Kachujin

archetype: the row is keyed by V1 archetype (pitborn), so every pitborn clone (the Minotaur, Lord Gourd, Kachujin, The King, The Titan's Envoy, Ryo) draws this blade until rows can be keyed by profile
clips: the 106 body plays the sword clip family (clipsAs cleaver); the sim keeps the cleaver's moves, timing and damage
sweeps: V1's hero-rig cleaver blade table, not re-baked on this blade or Kachujin's body
